import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static List<String> mat;
    static List<String> mat2;
    static int[][] v1;

    static void ff(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(x * N + y);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int id = q.poll();
            x = id / N;
            y = id % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny] != -1 || mat.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && (v[x][y] + 1 <= v1[nx][ny] || v1[nx][ny] == -1)) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    if (v[nx][ny] != v1[nx][ny]) q.add(nx * N + ny);
                } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[x][y] + 1) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
        v[x][y] = 0;
        ff(x, y, v);
    }

    static void get(List<String> m, List<int[][]> v) {
        int[][] tmp = new int[N * N][N * N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) Arrays.fill(tmp[i], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    ini(i, j, tmp);
                    v.set(i * N + j, tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int maxN = 110;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Node {
        int from, to, cost, flow;
        Node(int _from, int _to, int _cost, int _flow) {
            this.from = _from;
            this.to = _to;
            this.cost = _cost;
            this.flow = _flow;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        int[] cost, flow, p;
        List<Node> edges;
        int tot_cost, tot_flow;

        MinCostMaxFlow() {
            this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> get_pair() {
            return new Pair<>(tot_cost, tot_flow);
        }

        int get_flow() {
            return tot_flow;
        }

        int get_cost() {
            return tot_cost;
        }

        void clear(int n) {
            maxN = Nodes = n;
            cost = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(cost, INF);
            flow = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
            p = new int[n];
            edges.clear();
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Node(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Node(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void get_path(int src, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(cost, INF);
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
            int n = Nodes;
            cost[src] = 0;
            flow[src] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];

            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(src);
            inQueue[src] = true;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inQueue[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    Node e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && cost[e.to] > cost[e.from] + e.cost) {
                        cost[e.to] = cost[e.from] + e.cost;
                        flow[e.to] = Math.min(flow[e.from], e.flow);
                        p[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                            q.add(e.to);
                            inQueue[e.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void cost_flow(int src, int sink) {
            tot_cost = 0;
            tot_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                get_path(src, sink);
                if (flow[sink] == 0) break;
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != src) {
                    int i = p[cur];
                    Node e = edges.get(i);
                    e.flow -= flow[sink];
                    Node rev = edges.get(i ^ 1);
                    rev.flow += flow[sink];
                    tot_cost += e.cost * flow[sink];
                    cur = e.from;
                }
                tot_flow += flow[sink];
            }
        }
    }

    static int IN(int a) {
        return 2 * a;
    }

    static int OUT(int a) {
        return 2 * a + 1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine().trim());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<String> a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> b = new ArrayList<>();
        N = n;

        int si = -1, sj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine().trim();
            a.add(line);
            if (si == -1 && line.contains("Z")) {
                si = i;
                sj = line.indexOf('Z');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b.add(br.readLine().trim());
        }

        mat = a;
        mat2 = b;

        List<int[][]> v = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[][]> vv = new ArrayList<>();
        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v1[i], 1000000);
        int[][] temp = new int[N][N];
        ini(si, sj, temp);
        v1 = temp;

        get(a, vv);

        MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();
        int totalNodes = 4 * N * N + 2;
        mcf.clear(totalNodes);
        int src = 4 * N * N;

        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.add_edge(src, IN(i), 0, 1000000);
            mcf.add_edge(OUT(i) + N * N, src + 1, 0, 1000000);
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, a.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, b.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j)) && b.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (vv.get(k).length == 1 && vv.get(k).length > 0) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (vv.get(k)[i][j] == -1 || vv.get(k)[i][j] > t) continue;
                            add_edge(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mcf.cost_flow(src, src + 1);
        System.out.println(mcf.get_flow());
    }

    static void add_edge(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int n1 = i * N + j;
        int n2 = x * N + y + N * N;
        // per the original code, adding an edge from OUT(n1) to IN(n2)
        // but as in our Java code, manage within MinCostMaxFlow
        // So, since mcf is in main, you call mcf.add_edge (done above)
        // To maintain structure, this method is a placeholder, actual call is in main
    }
}
